clips.title: The story
paras: At Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore, young druids gather water to investigate a poison killing local wildlife. The Cenarion Circle gives them empty samplers for water from the cave mouth.

Cliffspring Falls feeds northern Darkshore, so trouble in its headwaters threatens the local wildlife. When a wasting poison began killing the region’s deer, Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle gave empty samplers to young druids sent from Moonglade. They must reach the cliffs by the falls and gather water at a cave entrance overrun by hostile naga.
